title: Rubric model and builder
agent_directive: This JSON is the complete task spec. First read docs/prompts/_standards.json once, then load the skills in `skills`. Read only the `spec_sections` of docs/fypms-docs.md (grep the FR id; never open the whole file). Build only what `build` lists and reply with `reply_format` from _standards.json.
build: models/rubric (schema, repo) and src/lib/rubrics/validate.ts (pure): criteria ids unique, sum of max_points equals max_score, supervisor_weight_pct + panel_weight_pct equals 100, at least one criterion, category one of the three allowed values. Unit-tested.

src/app/actions/manage-rubric.ts: create, update, duplicate, activate, archive. Activation sets exactly one is_active rubric in a transaction. Update or delete is blocked when any evaluation references the rubric (return 409).

/rubrics page (coordinator/admin): list with Active badge, builder sheet (add/remove criteria rows, category select, live totals and validation indicators), 'Start from template' (Oral Defense 30, System Demo 40, Technical Architecture 30 out of 100, weights 40/60), Activate button.
acceptance: Invalid weights or point totals cannot be saved
Only one rubric is active at any time
